parts.content:
# Dialog — company parts extension (`extends: core/behaviors/dialog`)

This file is the **company-only delta** to the core markup contract
([`core/behaviors/dialog/parts.md`](../../../core/behaviors/dialog/parts.md)). It is purely
**additive**: the composed contract is `core.parts ∪ company.parts.extend` (behavior-layer-design.md
§3.2 / §4.2). It adds **no** new `data-state` value and **redefines no** core part — it only
introduces brand chrome. Like the core `parts.md`, this is a human-readable spec, **not** a code
dependency: behavior sets these attributes, `company/design/dialog.css` styles them, and neither
imports the other.

## Added part (`part="…"`)

| Part          | Element role                                              | Notes |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------|-------|
| `brandHeader` | A company brand bar rendered at the top of `content`     | Optional; rendered only when `ctx.brandHeader` is true (the additive config key from `machine.patch.js`). Styled BLUE by `company/design/dialog.css`, layered AFTER core CSS. |
| `minimize`    | The minimize window-control button (in `brandHeader`)    | Company-only. Wired to the `MINIMIZE` event; styled YELLOW. Shown while `open`. |
| `restore`     | The restore/maximize window-control button (in `brandHeader`) | Company-only. Wired to the `RESTORE` event; styled YELLOW. Shown while `minimized` — it lives in `brandHeader`, the one part the `minimized` data-state keeps visible, so restore is always reachable. |

The company demo also re-skins the core `close` part to brand RED when it sits inside the
brand header — an additive CSS override (company layer loads after core), not a core edit.

## Added state vocabulary (from `machine.patch.js`)

The company patch adds one new FSM state and one new event (additive, monotonic — no core state or
transition is removed or rebound):

| FSM state   | Meaning                                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `minimized` | Dialog collapsed to its brand header; `RESTORE` → `open`, `CLOSE` → `closed`. |

| Event       | On state | Effect                                  |
|-------------|----------|-----------------------------------------|
| `MINIMIZE`  | `open`   | Added to core `open` (new event key) → `minimized`. |
| `RESTORE`   | `minimized` | `minimized` → `open`.                |

> `data-state` therefore composes to `{ open, closed, minimized }`. The core pair
> `{ open, closed }` is untouched; `minimized` is the only addition, and design MAY style it
> (e.g. collapse `content` to show only `brandHeader`) or fall back to the open treatment when
> unstyled. `CLOSE` from `minimized` goes straight to `closed`, matching the core close path.

## Union result

Composed parts = `overlay, content, title, close` (core) **∪** `brandHeader, minimize, restore` (company).
Composed `data-state` = `open, closed` (core) **∪** `minimized` (company).
